title: License a private health facility
what: Hold a licence for a private hospital or day-procedure centre before conducting it.

sources.title: Health Service Establishments Act 2006 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a private hospital unless – (a) the private hospital is licensed; and (b) the person is the licensee.
